thread:
zoe: Quick heads-up — hit a reproducible hang in the Next starter when using ephemeral tokens with edge streaming.

rahul: What symptoms are you seeing?

zoe: The stream opens, then if our token rotation fires mid-request the SDK retry reconnects but continues to send the original Authorization header. Client never receives further chunks.

emily: Which SDK version in the starter?

zoe: @redwood/sdk@0.9.2 (template from templates repo). Vercel edge runtime. Python client is fine, JS one replays old header.

rahul: Minimal repro from the starter (edge route):

```
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const t = await getEphemeral(req.cookies.sid);
  const stream = await redwood.stream({ model: 'redwood/fast-13b', prompt: req.body.prompt, token: t });
  stream.pipe(res);
}
```

emily: Any logs to confirm rotation vs retry?

zoe: Yep:
```
[2026-03-25T08:22:01Z] fetch token id=tmp-9 ttl=20s
[2026-03-25T08:22:19Z] token rotated id=tmp-10
[2026-03-25T08:22:20Z] sdk retry attempt=1 Authorization: Bearer tmp-9
[2026-03-25T08:22:20Z] client waiting for CHUNK_END
```

rahul: Looks like closure captured the header. Short-term workaround: have the server return a one-time presigned URL or make the browser fetch a fresh token immediately before opening the stream.

emily: Longer-term fix: JS SDK should accept an authResolver (callback) that's invoked on each request/retry to get fresh headers. Keep fallback to static apiKey for backwards compatibility.

zoe: Agreed. Also add an e2e test that simulates rotation mid-stream and asserts the retry uses new auth. We currently lack ephemeral-token streaming coverage.

rahul: I'll prototype authResolver API: { auth: async () => fetch('/api/ephemeral').then(r=>r.json()).token } and wire into retry path. If tests pass we can roll a 0.9.x patch and update the starter.

emily: Please add a short example in the starter README under "Edge auth patterns" documenting authResolver and the presigned-URL workaround so new users don't hit this during onboarding.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch feat/js-auth-resolver  checks running.

zoe: Thanks — I'll open the starter PR once the client change is merged. If anyone has other repros (cookie-store rotation, GCP edge, self-hosted), drop them here.

emily: :thumbsup:
